title: Room booking for a co-working chain
summary: Let members book rooms across many sites, with no double bookings and sensible credits.
context: Indiranagar Desks runs 25 co-working sites. Members buy credits and spend them on rooms by the half hour. Rooms have different rates at different hours, and companies share a pool of credits across staff.
Double bookings happen weekly, usually around recurring meetings. Rooms sit empty when someone books and does not come, and members ask for refunds when they cancel late.
must_handle: Two people cannot hold one room for an overlapping time.
A weekly meeting is a series, with single changes allowed.
Credits never go negative, even when two staff book at once.
A no-show frees the room after a while and follows a clear credit rule.
Times are right for sites and for members travelling elsewhere.
show_in_answer: The tables for rooms, bookings, series and credits.
How an overlap is prevented at the database.
How a booking and its credit change happen together.
How a change to one meeting in a series works.
